# Remove Events

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Removes the given events from the calendar.

## Syntax

~~~~text
removeEvents(events: <#Variable#>, includeFuture: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
removeEvents(events: myEvents, includeFuture: true)
~~~~
